props.gloss_en: Rav Huna: [to draw water from] a boat, one extends from it a projection of any size and fills
Rav Chisda and Rabba bar Rav Huna: one makes a place of four and fills
Rav Huna holds: we measure the karmelit from the ground
and the air [above the sea] is an exempt place
by law a projection too should not be required; it is only so that he has a sign
Rav Chisda and Rabba bar Rav Huna hold: we measure the karmelit from the water's surface
water is solid ground; if he does not make a place of four he carries from a karmelit to the private domain
Rabba bar Avuh: we have it by tradition that a boat does not travel in less than ten [handbreadths]
he throws [the waste water] onto the side of the boat
they did not decree against [an act done by] his force in a karmelit
the baraita: [with] a boat, one may carry neither from it into the sea nor from the sea into it
R' Yehuda: [if the boat is] ten deep and not ten high -- one carries from it into the sea
...but not from the sea into it
rather, is it not [where he throws it] onto its edge
Rav Huna: these small boats of Meishan -- one carries in them only within four cubits
we said this only where there is not four within three [handbreadths]; but where there is four within three -- we have no [problem] with it
and if he filled them with reeds and willow branches -- we have no [problem] with it
R' Yosei b. R' Yehuda: one stuck a reed in the public domain with a basket at its top, threw and it rested on it -- liable
Rav Nachman: let us say 'lower the partition' -- here too [at the boats of Meishan] let us say 'lower the partition'
and they taught on it: and the Sages exempt
the baraita: a column in the public domain ten high and four wide, its base not four, and its narrow part three -- one threw and it rested on it -- liable
there it is a partition that goats pass through
here it is a partition that goats do not pass through
Rav Ashi: the passage of fish is not called passage
R' Tavla: does a hanging partition permit [carrying] in a ruin?
Rav: a hanging partition permits only in water -- it is a leniency the Sages were lenient in water

supports.gloss_en: ומנא תימרא? דתניא... רבי יהודה אומר: עמוקה עשרה ואין גבוהה עשרה מטלטלין מתוכה לים... אלא לאו אחודה, ושמע מינה כחו בכרמלית לא גזרו. שמע מינה (101a.1)
והתניא: עמוד ברשות הרבים גבוה עשרה ורחב ארבעה ואין בעיקרו ארבעה... חייב; אלמא אמרינן גוד אחית מחיצתא, הכא נמי גוד אחית מחיצתא
